summary: Hardened src/goal/plan-autocheck.ts JSON parsing by removing the local extractJsonObjectCandidates implementation, importing extractJsonObjectCandidates/repairJsonText from src/goal/json-repair.ts, and adding repairJsonText fallback parsing in parseJsonLines, parseDecisionFromText line parsing, and parseDecisionFromText candidate parsing (repair only on parse failure). Added regression tests in src/goal/plan-autocheck.test.ts for malformed decision JSON '{"approved":true}}' and malformed JSONL result line with trailing brace. Verification passed: pnpm vitest run src/goal/plan-autocheck.test.ts and pnpm build.
